notes: phase1-design §10.3. REAL_MODEL_ID is the full Claude model ID the gate runs with (the first run's modelUsage key must equal it, else the round is void). CONFIRM_MODEL_ID is the confirmation round (--model claude-opus-5-5). CODEX_MODEL_ID: the full Codex model ID for --client codex; null runs Codex's default model and records the one its session log names.
